profile.summary: ovangle is a mid-level JavaScript developer with specialized expertise in TypeScript, ES6+ JavaScript, and modern build tooling (Webpack). Their contributions to Moment.js demonstrate strong skills in legacy code modernization, static typing, and backend-focused JavaScript development. While primarily working with Node.js and build systems, their work shows proficiency in modular ES6 patterns, type safety improvements, and Webpack optimizations. The developer has indirect evidence of asynchronous programming experience through Node.js and Webpack async loading patterns, though no explicit async/await examples are present in their contributions. Their focus on TypeScript declarations and build-time optimizations indicates a deep understanding of type systems and modern JavaScript tooling.
